why_it_matters: This closes the residual-shape program for the stripfront endpoint: after discoveries 0117-0119 (G-hs3 closed in the machine - wall domination + lifted M-wire + margin - and machined at the endpoint), the G-hs1 face was the last bare inequality in the residual. Part B8 shows it is the B2 pin family at the witness zero, same content, checkable shape: each pin is a statement about ONE witness zero and concrete kernel quantities (the fill, |W_n|, the A4.3 mass, the absorption), which is exactly the form the data program measures (E1ClauseV3 above G, the S1Face atom). Consequence: the machined stripfront endpoint at tPT2 has NO analytic face left - its residual is a finite conjunction of (a) data pins at individual witness zeros (P1-P4), (b) a zero-exclusion record face (window band), and (c) a cited classical mass bound (the 1.6 convexity evaluation at the off-pair point). Every remaining obligation is either checkable against a zeta record at the height or a cited classical bound; nothing requires new analytic machinery inside the tree. What the program now needs is data/records, not theorems: zeta verification above 3,000,175,332,800 extending [Z-PT2], the window-band zero-exclusion above the frontier, and the per-witness kernel pins at strip-band heights above the frontier. No RH claim.
next: The endpoint residual at tPT2 is now data/record content only: (1) the P1-P4 pin family at strip-band witness zeros above tPT2 - measurable by the same E1ClauseV3/S1Face machinery that measures them below G, once zeta records exist at those heights; (2) the window zero-exclusion face - a zero-free record (Re - 1/2 in (0, 1/200), t > tPT2) in the style of the Platt-Trudgian verification, i.e., the NEXT classical verification record to be produced or cited; (3) the machined hs3 face - a per-witness classical convexity evaluation (the 1.6 mass bound at the off-pair), checkable against the same zeta record. Candidate in-tree follow-ups: wire the pin family to the existing E1ClauseV3 data clauses where the heights overlap below tPT2 (a consistency check of the faces on measured territory), and record in docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md the precise data obligations the endpoint now carries.
